
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zyly/p/20005253" title="发布于 2026-05-09 21:10">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">龙芯2k0300 - 走马观碑组按键驱动移植</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</p>
<p>开发板 ：久久派开发板<br>
<code>eMMC</code> ：<code>8GB</code><br>
<code>DDR4</code> ：<code>512MB</code><br>
<code>u-boot</code> ：<code>u-boot 2022.04</code><br>
<code>linux</code> ：<code>6.12</code><br>
<code>rootfs</code>：<code>buildroot-2024.08</code><br>
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</p>
<p>在《<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zyly/p/19731118" target="_blank">龙芯<code>2k0300</code> - 走马观碑组第<code>21</code>届智能汽车竞赛软硬件设计</a>》中，我们使用久久派开发板作为智能车主控板。前面已经完成了<code>PWM</code>、编码器、显示屏、摄像头等模块的移植，这一节我们继续补充久久派板载按键驱动。</p>
<p>久久派开发板上有两个用户按键：</p>
<img src="https://gitee.com/zyly2033/blog-pic/raw/master/20260509210534034.png" style="zoom: 80%">
<p>其中：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>KEY0</code>：对应<code>UART2_TXD</code>，也就是<code>GPIO44</code>；</li>
<li><code>KEY1</code>：对应<code>UART2_RXD</code>，也就是<code>GPIO45</code>。</li>
</ul>
<p>这两个按键可以用于智能车的发车、停车、模式切换、参数确认、调试触发等功能。不过内核驱动不应该直接处理“发车”这类业务逻辑，驱动只负责把硬件按键转换成标准<code>Linux input</code>事件，具体业务逻辑交给用户态程序处理。</p>
<h3 id="一久久派key0key1按键">一、久久派<code>KEY0</code>/<code>KEY1</code>按键</h3>
<h4 id="11-硬件连接关系">1.1 硬件连接关系</h4>
<p>久久派两个按键和龙芯<code>2K0300</code>的连接关系如下：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>按键</th>
<th>复用引脚</th>
<th>GPIO</th>
<th>默认电平</th>
<th>按下电平</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>KEY0</code></td>
<td><code>UART2_TXD</code></td>
<td><code>GPIO44</code></td>
<td>高电平</td>
<td>低电平</td>
<td>低有效按键</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>KEY1</code></td>
<td><code>UART2_RXD</code></td>
<td><code>GPIO45</code></td>
<td>高电平</td>
<td>低电平</td>
<td>低有效按键</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>也就是说，按键没有按下时，<code>GPIO</code> 原始电平为高；按下按键后，<code>GPIO</code> 原始电平被拉低。</p>
<p>因此设备树中必须使用<code>GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW</code>描述按键极性。这样驱动通过<code>gpiod_get_value_cansleep()</code>读取 <code>GPIO</code> 时，内核<code>gpiod</code>框架会自动把低有效电平转换为逻辑值：</p>
<ul>
<li>未按下：逻辑值<code>0</code>；</li>
<li>按下：逻辑值<code>1</code>。</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="12-为什么使用input子系统">1.2 为什么使用<code>input</code>子系统</h4>
<p>按键驱动有很多种实现方式，比如：</p>
<ul>
<li>字符设备：用户态通过<code>read()</code>读取自定义结构体；</li>
<li><code>mis</code>c 设备：用户态打开<code>/dev/xxx</code>读取按键状态；</li>
<li><code>input</code>设备：驱动上报标准<code>EV_KEY</code>事件。</li>
</ul>
<p>这里选择<code>Linux input</code>子系统，原因是：</p>
<ul>
<li>按键本身就是标准输入设备，适合用<code>EV_KEY</code>事件描述；</li>
<li>用户态可以直接读取<code>/dev/input/eventX</code>；</li>
<li>后续也可以用<code>evtest</code>、<code>libinput</code>等工具调试；</li>
<li>驱动只负责上报按下、释放事件，不和智能车业务逻辑耦合。</li>
</ul>
<p>本文中驱动注册的 <code>input</code> 设备名称为：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">LS2K300 99Pi Keys
</code></pre>
<p>默认键值映射如下：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>按键</th>
<th>Linux key code</th>
<th>数值</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>KEY0</code></td>
<td><code>KEY_PROG1</code></td>
<td><code>148</code></td>
<td>可作为发车、确认等自定义功能键</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>KEY1</code></td>
<td><code>KEY_PROG2</code></td>
<td><code>149</code></td>
<td>可作为停车、模式切换等自定义功能键</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="二按键设备驱动">二、按键设备驱动</h3>
<h4 id="21-创建驱动目录">2.1 创建驱动目录</h4>
<p>在<code>driver</code>目录下创建<code>key_driver</code>子目录：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:~$ cd /opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/driver
zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/driver$ mkdir key_driver
zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/driver$ cd key_driver
</code></pre>
<p>目录结构如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/driver/key_driver$ tree .
.
├── key_driver.c
├── Makefile
└── README.md
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-key_driverc">2.2 <code>key_driver.c</code></h4>
<p>按键驱动的核心思路如下：</p>
<ul>
<li>通过设备树匹配<code>compatible = "ls2k300-99pi-keys"</code>；</li>
<li>获取<code>key0-gpios</code>和<code>key1-gpios</code>；</li>
<li>将 <code>GPIO</code> 转换为 <code>IRQ</code>；</li>
<li>同时监听上升沿和下降沿；</li>
<li>中断触发后启动延迟工作队列做消抖；</li>
<li>消抖完成后读取 <code>GPIO</code> 逻辑状态；</li>
<li>通过<code>input_report_key()</code>和<code>input_sync()</code>上报按键事件。</li>
</ul>
<p>驱动头文件和基本宏定义如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">#include &lt;linux/gpio/consumer.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/input.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/interrupt.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/module.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/of.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/platform_device.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/slab.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/workqueue.h&gt;

#define DRIVER_NAME "ls2k300_99pi_keys"
#define DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_MS 20
</code></pre>
<p>单个按键运行状态使用<code>struct key_button</code>描述：</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">struct key_device;

struct key_button {
	const char *name;
	struct gpio_desc *gpiod;
	int irq;
	unsigned int code;
	bool last_pressed;
	struct delayed_work work;
	struct key_device *parent;
};
</code></pre>
<p>整个双按键设备使用<code>struct key_device</code>描述：</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">struct key_device {
	struct device *dev;
	struct input_dev *input;
	struct key_button buttons[2];
	unsigned int debounce_ms;
};
</code></pre>
<p>默认按键名称和键值：</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static const char *const default_names[] = {
	"KEY0",
	"KEY1",
};

static const unsigned int default_codes[] = {
	KEY_PROG1,
	KEY_PROG2,
};
</code></pre>
<h5 id="221-读取按键状态">2.2.1 读取按键状态</h5>
<p>由于设备树使用<code>GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW</code>，所以<code>gpiod_get_value_cansleep()</code>返回的是逻辑值，而不是原始电平。也就是说，按键按下时返回<code>1</code>，松开时返回<code>0</code>。</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static bool button_pressed(struct key_button *button)
{
	int value = gpiod_get_value_cansleep(button-&gt;gpiod);

	if (value &lt; 0) {
		dev_warn(button-&gt;parent-&gt;dev, "failed to read %s GPIO: %d\n",
			 button-&gt;name, value);
		return button-&gt;last_pressed;
	}

	return value != 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h5 id="222-上报按键事件">2.2.2 上报按键事件</h5>
<p>只有当前状态和上一次状态不一致时才上报事件，避免重复打印和重复上报。</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static void report_button_state(struct key_button *button)
{
	bool pressed = button_pressed(button);

	if (pressed == button-&gt;last_pressed)
		return;

	button-&gt;last_pressed = pressed;
	input_report_key(button-&gt;parent-&gt;input, button-&gt;code, pressed);
	input_sync(button-&gt;parent-&gt;input);
	dev_info(button-&gt;parent-&gt;dev, "%s %s code=%u\n",
		 button-&gt;name,
		 pressed ? "pressed" : "released",
		 button-&gt;code);
}
</code></pre>
<h5 id="223-中断与消抖">2.2.3 中断与消抖</h5>
<p>机械按键按下和释放时会出现抖动，因此不能在中断中立即上报事件。这里中断处理函数只负责启动一个延迟工作，真正读取 <code>GPIO</code> 和上报 <code>input</code> 事件在工作队列中完成。</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static void key_work(struct work_struct *work)
{
	struct key_button *button =
		container_of(to_delayed_work(work), struct key_button, work);

	report_button_state(button);
}

static irqreturn_t key_irq(int irq, void *data)
{
	struct key_button *button = data;

	mod_delayed_work(system_wq,
			 &amp;button-&gt;work,
			 msecs_to_jiffies(button-&gt;parent-&gt;debounce_ms));
	return IRQ_HANDLED;
}
</code></pre>
<h5 id="224-初始化单个按键">2.2.4 初始化单个按键</h5>
<p><code>setup_button()</code>完成一个按键的 <code>GPIO</code> 获取、<code>IRQ</code> 映射、<code>input capability</code> 设置和中断注册。</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static int setup_button(struct key_device *keys, int index)
{
	struct device *dev = keys-&gt;dev;
	struct key_button *button = &amp;keys-&gt;buttons[index];
	char gpio_name[8];
	int ret;

	snprintf(gpio_name, sizeof(gpio_name), "key%d", index);

	button-&gt;name = default_names[index];
	button-&gt;code = default_codes[index];
	button-&gt;parent = keys;
	INIT_DELAYED_WORK(&amp;button-&gt;work, key_work);

	if (dev-&gt;of_node) {
		of_property_read_string_index(dev-&gt;of_node,
					      "linux,key-names",
					      index,
					      &amp;button-&gt;name);
		of_property_read_u32_index(dev-&gt;of_node,
					   "linux,key-codes",
					   index,
					   &amp;button-&gt;code);
	}

	button-&gt;gpiod = devm_gpiod_get(dev, gpio_name, GPIOD_IN);
	if (IS_ERR(button-&gt;gpiod)) {
		ret = PTR_ERR(button-&gt;gpiod);
		dev_err(dev, "failed to get %s GPIO: %d\n", gpio_name, ret);
		return ret;
	}

	button-&gt;irq = gpiod_to_irq(button-&gt;gpiod);
	if (button-&gt;irq &lt; 0) {
		dev_err(dev, "failed to map %s GPIO to IRQ: %d\n",
			button-&gt;name, button-&gt;irq);
		return button-&gt;irq;
	}

	button-&gt;last_pressed = button_pressed(button);
	input_set_capability(keys-&gt;input, EV_KEY, button-&gt;code);

	ret = devm_request_threaded_irq(dev,
					button-&gt;irq,
					NULL,
					key_irq,
					IRQF_TRIGGER_RISING |
					IRQF_TRIGGER_FALLING |
					IRQF_ONESHOT,
					button-&gt;name,
					button);
	if (ret) {
		dev_err(dev, "failed to request IRQ for %s: %d\n",
			button-&gt;name, ret);
		return ret;
	}

	dev_info(dev, "%s registered on IRQ %d code %u initial=%s\n",
		 button-&gt;name,
		 button-&gt;irq,
		 button-&gt;code,
		 button-&gt;last_pressed ? "pressed" : "released");
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h5 id="225-probe函数">2.2.5 <code>probe</code>函数</h5>
<p><code>probe</code>函数中分配驱动上下文、初始化 <code>input</code> 设备、初始化两个按键，最后注册 <code>input</code> 设备。</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static int key_probe(struct platform_device *pdev)
{
	struct key_device *keys;
	int ret;
	int i;

	dev_info(&amp;pdev-&gt;dev, "probing %s input driver\n", DRIVER_NAME);

	keys = devm_kzalloc(&amp;pdev-&gt;dev, sizeof(*keys), GFP_KERNEL);
	if (!keys)
		return -ENOMEM;

	keys-&gt;dev = &amp;pdev-&gt;dev;
	keys-&gt;debounce_ms = DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_MS;
	device_property_read_u32(&amp;pdev-&gt;dev,
				 "debounce-interval-ms",
				 &amp;keys-&gt;debounce_ms);

	keys-&gt;input = devm_input_allocate_device(&amp;pdev-&gt;dev);
	if (!keys-&gt;input)
		return -ENOMEM;

	keys-&gt;input-&gt;name = "LS2K300 99Pi Keys";
	keys-&gt;input-&gt;phys = "ls2k300-99pi-keys/input0";
	keys-&gt;input-&gt;id.bustype = BUS_HOST;

	for (i = 0; i &lt; ARRAY_SIZE(keys-&gt;buttons); ++i) {
		ret = setup_button(keys, i);
		if (ret)
			return ret;
	}

	ret = input_register_device(keys-&gt;input);
	if (ret) {
		dev_err(&amp;pdev-&gt;dev, "failed to register input device: %d\n", ret);
		return ret;
	}

	platform_set_drvdata(pdev, keys);
	dev_info(&amp;pdev-&gt;dev, "LS2K300 99Pi key input driver ready: %s\n",
		 keys-&gt;input-&gt;name);
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h5 id="226-设备树匹配表">2.2.6 设备树匹配表</h5>
<p>这里需要注意<code>compatible</code>，设备树节点和驱动模块要匹配。</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">static const struct of_device_id key_of_match[] = {
	{ .compatible = "ls2k300-99pi-keys" },
	{ }
};
MODULE_DEVICE_TABLE(of, key_of_match);

static struct platform_driver key_driver = {
	.probe = key_probe,
	.remove = key_remove,
	.driver = {
		.name = DRIVER_NAME,
		.of_match_table = key_of_match,
	},
};

module_platform_driver(key_driver);

MODULE_AUTHOR("zhengyang");
MODULE_DESCRIPTION("LS2K300 99Pi GPIO key input driver");
MODULE_LICENSE("GPL");
</code></pre>
<h4 id="23-makefile">2.3 <code>Makefile</code></h4>
<p><code>Makefile</code>如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-makefile">KERNELDIR ?= /opt/2k0300/build-2k0300/workspace/linux-6.12
PWD := $(shell pwd)
CROSS_COMPILE ?= loongarch64-linux-gnu-
ARCH := loongarch

BUILD_DIR := build
KO_DIR := ko

obj-m := ls2k300_99pi_keys.o
ls2k300_99pi_keys-y := key_driver.o

all: prepare compile move_files

prepare:
	@mkdir -p $(BUILD_DIR) $(KO_DIR)
	@echo "key_driver: prepare build directories"

compile:
	@echo "key_driver: build kernel module"
	make -C $(KERNELDIR) ARCH=$(ARCH) CROSS_COMPILE=$(CROSS_COMPILE) M=$(PWD) modules

move_files:
	@find . -type f \
		-not -path "./$(BUILD_DIR)/*" -not -path "./$(KO_DIR)/*" \
		\( -name '*.o' -o -name '*.mod' -o -name '*.mod.o' -o -name '*.mod.c' -o -name '.*.cmd' -o -name 'modules.order' -o -name 'Module.symvers' \) \
		! -name '*.ko' -exec mv -t $(BUILD_DIR)/ {} +
	@find . -type f \
		-not -path "./$(BUILD_DIR)/*" -not -path "./$(KO_DIR)/*" \
		-name '*.ko' -exec cp -f {} $(KO_DIR)/ \; -exec rm -f {} \;

clean:
	@echo "key_driver: clean build outputs"
	make -C $(KERNELDIR) ARCH=$(ARCH) CROSS_COMPILE=$(CROSS_COMPILE) M=$(PWD) clean
	rm -rf *.ko *.o *.mod *.mod.o *.mod.c *.symvers *.order .*.cmd .tmp_versions build ko

.PHONY: all prepare compile move_files clean
</code></pre>
<h3 id="三新增设备树节点">三、新增设备树节点</h3>
<h4 id="31-keys节点">3.1 <code>keys</code>节点</h4>
<p>进入内核源码目录：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:~$ cd /opt/2k0300/build-2k0300/workspace/linux-6.12
</code></pre>
<p>修改<code>arch/loongarch/boot/dts/ls2k300_99pi.dtsi</code>，在根节点<code>/</code>下增加<code>keys</code>节点：</p>
<pre><code class="language-dts">keys {
	compatible = "ls2k300-99pi-keys";
	key0-gpios = &lt;&amp;gpio 44 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW&gt;;
	key1-gpios = &lt;&amp;gpio 45 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW&gt;;
	debounce-interval-ms = &lt;20&gt;;
	linux,key-codes = &lt;148 149&gt;;
	linux,key-names = "KEY0", "KEY1";
	status = "okay";
};
</code></pre>
<p>说明：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>compatible</code>必须和驱动中的<code>of_device_id</code>一致；</li>
<li><code>key0-gpios</code>对应<code>GPIO44</code>；</li>
<li><code>key1-gpios</code>对应<code>GPIO45</code>；</li>
<li><code>GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW</code>表示按键低有效；</li>
<li><code>debounce-interval-ms = &lt;20&gt;</code>表示消抖时间为<code>20ms</code>；</li>
<li><code>linux,key-codes = &lt;148 149&gt;</code>对应<code>KEY_PROG1</code>和<code>KEY_PROG2</code>。</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="32-禁用uart2">3.2 禁用<code>UART2</code></h4>
<p>由于<code>KEY0</code>和<code>KEY1</code>占用了<code>UART2_TXD</code>和<code>UART2_RXD</code>，所以必须禁用<code>uart2</code>，避免串口和按键同时占用同一组引脚。</p>
<pre><code class="language-dts">&amp;uart2 {
	status = "disabled";
};
</code></pre>
<p>久久派默认可以把<code>GPIO44</code>和<code>GPIO45</code>作为普通 <code>GPIO</code> 使用，因此这里不需要额外新增<code>pinctrl</code>节点把<code>UART2_TXD</code>/<code>UART2_RXD</code>切回 <code>GPIO</code>。</p>
<h3 id="四应用程序">四、应用程序</h3>
<h4 id="41-创建测试程序目录">4.1 创建测试程序目录</h4>
<p>在<code>example</code>目录下创建<code>key_app</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/example$ mkdir key_app
zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/example$ cd key_app
</code></pre>
<p>目录结构如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/example/key_app$ tree .
.
├── main.c
└── Makefile
</code></pre>
<h4 id="42-mainc">4.2 <code>main.c</code></h4>
<p>用户态测试程序的逻辑如下：</p>
<ul>
<li>默认查找 <code>input</code> 设备名称<code>LS2K300 99Pi Keys</code>；</li>
<li>如果找不到，可以通过<code>--device /dev/input/eventX</code>手动指定；</li>
<li>打开<code>/dev/input/eventX</code>；</li>
<li>使用<code>poll()</code>等待 <code>input</code> 事件；</li>
<li>只打印<code>KEY_PROG1</code>和<code>KEY_PROG2</code>对应的按键事件。</li>
</ul>
<p>关键宏定义如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">#include &lt;errno.h&gt;
#include &lt;ctype.h&gt;
#include &lt;fcntl.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/input.h&gt;
#include &lt;poll.h&gt;
#include &lt;stdio.h&gt;
#include &lt;stdlib.h&gt;
#include &lt;string.h&gt;
#include &lt;unistd.h&gt;

#define DEFAULT_DEVICE_NAME "LS2K300 99Pi Keys"
#define DEFAULT_KEY0_CODE KEY_PROG1
#define DEFAULT_KEY1_CODE KEY_PROG2
</code></pre>
<p>查找 <code>input</code> 设备名称<code>LS2K300 99Pi Keys</code>；</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">/*
 * @brief 根据 input 设备名称查找对应 /dev/input/eventX 路径。
 * @param target_name 期望的 input 设备名称，必须与驱动注册名称完全一致。
 * @param out 输出缓冲区，用于保存 /dev/input/eventX。
 * @param out_size 输出缓冲区大小。
 * @return 0 表示找到设备，负数表示未找到或读取失败。
 */
static int find_input_device(const char *target_name, char *out, size_t out_size)
{
    FILE *file;
    char line[512];
    char name[128] = "";
    char event[64] = "";

    file = fopen("/proc/bus/input/devices", "r");
    if (!file) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open /proc/bus/input/devices: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }

    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), file)) {
        char *text = trim(line);

        if (text[0] == '\0') {
            if (event[0] != '\0' &amp;&amp; strcmp(name, target_name) == 0) {
                snprintf(out, out_size, "/dev/input/%s", event);
                fclose(file);
                return 0;
            }
            reset_device_block(name, event);
            continue;
        }

        if (strncmp(text, "N: Name=", 8) == 0) {
            read_quoted_value(text, name, sizeof(name));
            continue;
        }

        if (strncmp(text, "H: Handlers=", 12) == 0) {
            char *token = strtok(text, " \t");
            while (token) {
                if (strncmp(token, "event", 5) == 0) {
                    snprintf(event, sizeof(event), "%s", token);
                    break;
                }
                token = strtok(NULL, " \t");
            }
        }
    }

    fclose(file);

    if (event[0] != '\0' &amp;&amp; strcmp(name, target_name) == 0) {
        snprintf(out, out_size, "/dev/input/%s", event);
        return 0;
    }

    return -1;
}
</code></pre>
<p>将键值转换为按键名称：</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">/*
 * @brief 将按键键值转换为业务名称。
 * @param code input 子系统上报的 key code。
 * @return KEY0、KEY1 或 UNKNOWN 字符串。
 */
static const char *key_name(unsigned short code)
{
    if (code == DEFAULT_KEY0_CODE)
        return "KEY0";
    if (code == DEFAULT_KEY1_CODE)
        return "KEY1";
    return "UNKNOWN";
}
</code></pre>
<p>将 <code>input</code> 事件值转换为动作名称：</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">/*
 * @brief 将 input 按键状态值转换为动作名称。
 * @param value input_event.value，0 松开，1 按下，2 重复。
 * @return release、press、repeat 或 unknown 字符串。
 */
static const char *key_action(int value)
{
    switch (value) {
    case 0:
        return "release";
    case 1:
        return "press";
    case 2:
        return "repeat";
    default:
        return "unknown";
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>主循环读取 <code>input</code> 事件：</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">while (max_events &lt; 0 || event_count &lt; max_events) {
	struct pollfd pfd = {
		.fd = fd,
		.events = POLLIN,
	};
	struct input_event event;
	ssize_t nread;
	int ret;

	ret = poll(&amp;pfd, 1, -1);
	if (ret &lt; 0) {
		if (errno == EINTR)
			continue;
		fprintf(stderr, "poll failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
		break;
	}

	nread = read(fd, &amp;event, sizeof(event));
	if (nread != sizeof(event))
		continue;

	if (event.type != EV_KEY)
		continue;
	if (event.code != DEFAULT_KEY0_CODE &amp;&amp; event.code != DEFAULT_KEY1_CODE)
		continue;

	printf("%-4s %-7s code=%u value=%d time=%ld.%06ld\n",
	       key_name(event.code),
	       key_action(event.value),
	       event.code,
	       event.value,
	       (long)event.time.tv_sec,
	       (long)event.time.tv_usec);
	event_count++;
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="43-makefile">4.3 <code>Makefile</code></h4>
<pre><code class="language-makefile">TOOLCHAIN_DIR ?= ../../cross_lib/loongarch64-linux-gnu-gcc13.3/bin
CROSS_COMPILE ?= $(TOOLCHAIN_DIR)/loongarch64-linux-gnu-

ifeq ($(origin CC),default)
CC := $(CROSS_COMPILE)gcc
endif

CFLAGS ?= -Wall -Wextra -O2
TARGET := main

all:
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $(TARGET) main.c

clean:
	rm -rf *.o $(TARGET)

.PHONY: all clean
</code></pre>
<h3 id="五测试">五、测试</h3>
<h4 id="51-烧录设备树">5.1 烧录设备树</h4>
<h5 id="511-编译设备树">5.1.1 编译设备树</h5>
<p>如果需要单独编译设备树，可以在<code>driver</code>目录使用统一脚本：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:~$ cd /opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/driver
zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/driver$ ./build_driver.sh --target dtb
</code></pre>
<p>脚本内部等价于在 <code>Linux</code> 内核目录执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:~$ cd /opt/2k0300/build-2k0300/workspace/linux-6.12
zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/build-2k0300/workspace/linux-6.12$ source ../set_env.sh &amp;&amp; make dtbs V=1
</code></pre>
<h5 id="512-更新设备树">5.1.2 更新设备树</h5>
<p>将设备树拷贝到久久派并烧录到<code>SPI Nor Flash</code>的<code>dtb</code>分区：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/driver$ ./build_driver.sh --target dtb --deploy root@172.23.17.235
</code></pre>
<p>脚本会把<code>ls2k300_99pi_wifi.dtb</code>上传到目标板<code>/opt</code>目录，并在目标板执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD opt]# dd if=/opt/ls2k300_99pi_wifi.dtb of=/dev/mtdblock3 bs=1
[root@LS-GD opt]# sync
</code></pre>
<p>烧录完成后重启开发板：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD opt]# reboot
</code></pre>
<h4 id="52-安装驱动">5.2 安装驱动</h4>
<h5 id="521-编译并部署驱动">5.2.1 编译并部署驱动</h5>
<p>由于我们并没有将按键驱动源码放到内核源码树中，因此需要单独编译安装。</p>
<p>在<code>ubuntu</code>宿主机执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:~$ cd /opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/driver
zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/driver$ ./build_driver.sh --target key --deploy root@172.23.17.235
</code></pre>
<p>脚本会完成以下工作：</p>
<ul>
<li>调用内核外部模块构建流程生成<code>ls2k300_99pi_keys.ko</code>；</li>
<li>将模块复制到本地<code>driver/key_driver/install/</code>目录；</li>
<li>上传到开发板<code>/lib/modules/$(uname -r)/</code>目录；</li>
<li>执行<code>depmod -a $(uname -r)</code>更新模块依赖。</li>
</ul>
<p>部署日志示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">key local install file updated:
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang 16664  5月  9 20:52 /opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/driver/key_driver/install/ls2k300_99pi_keys.ko
Deploy /opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/driver/key_driver/install/ls2k300_99pi_keys.ko to root@172.23.17.235:/lib/modules/6.12.0.lsgd+/ls2k300_99pi_keys.ko
ls2k300_99pi_keys.ko 100%   16KB   3.2MB/s   00:00
depmod: WARNING: could not open modules.builtin at /lib/modules/6.12.0.lsgd+: No such file or directory
depmod: WARNING: could not open modules.builtin.modinfo at /lib/modules/6.12.0.lsgd+: No such file or directory
</code></pre>
<p>这里<code>depmod</code>的输出是警告，不是致命错误。含义是<code>/lib/modules/$(uname -r)/</code>目录缺少<code>modules.builtin</code>和<code>modules.builtin.modinfo</code>，不影响当前外部模块通过<code>modprobe</code>加载。</p>
<h5 id="522-检查模块-alias">5.2.2 检查模块 alias</h5>
<p>在开发板检查模块信息：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD ~]# modinfo /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/ls2k300_99pi_keys.ko | grep alias
alias:          of:N*T*Cls2k300-99pi-keysC*
alias:          of:N*T*Cls2k300-99pi-keys
</code></pre>
<h5 id="523-加载驱动">5.2.3 加载驱动</h5>
<p>手动加载驱动：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD ~]# modprobe ls2k300_99pi_keys
</code></pre>
<p>查看模块：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD ~]# lsmod | grep ls2k300_99pi_keys
ls2k300_99pi_keys      65536  0
</code></pre>
<p>查看内核日志：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD ~]# dmesg | grep -iE "Keys"
</code></pre>
<p>正常情况下可以看到类似输出：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">[  698.012212] ls2k300_99pi_keys keys: probing ls2k300_99pi_keys input driver
[  698.019241] ls2k300_99pi_keys keys: debounce interval: 20 ms
[  698.025993] ls2k300_99pi_keys keys: input device name: LS2K300 99Pi Keys
[  698.034795] ls2k300_99pi_keys keys: KEY0 registered on IRQ 72 code 148 initial=released
[  698.043222] ls2k300_99pi_keys keys: KEY1 registered on IRQ 73 code 149 initial=released
[  698.051871] input: LS2K300 99Pi Keys as /devices/platform/keys/input/input0
[  698.067180] ls2k300_99pi_keys keys: LS2K300 99Pi key input driver ready: LS2K300 99Pi Keys
</code></pre>
<h4 id="53-验证-input-设备">5.3 验证 input 设备</h4>
<p>查看<code>/proc/bus/input/devices</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD ~]# cat /proc/bus/input/devices
</code></pre>
<p>正常情况下可以看到类似内容：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">[root@LS-GD 6.12.0.lsgd+]# cat /proc/bus/input/devices
I: Bus=0019 Vendor=0000 Product=0000 Version=0000
N: Name="LS2K300 99Pi Keys"
P: Phys=ls2k300-99pi-keys/input0
S: Sysfs=/devices/platform/keys/input/input0
U: Uniq=
H: Handlers=kbd event0
B: PROP=0
B: EV=3
B: KEY=300000 0 0
</code></pre>
<p>这里重点关注：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Name="LS2K300 99Pi Keys"</code>；</li>
<li><code>Handlers</code>中存在<code>eventX</code>。</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="54-应用程序测试">5.4 应用程序测试</h4>
<h5 id="541-编译部署并运行">5.4.1 编译、部署并运行</h5>
<p>在宿主机<code>example</code>目录执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:~$ cd /opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/example
zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/example$ ./build_deploy_run.sh --app key_app --deploy root@172.23.17.235
</code></pre>
<p>也可以只编译部署，不立即运行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/example$ ./build_deploy_run.sh --app key_app --deploy root@172.23.17.235 --no-run
</code></pre>
<p>然后在开发板上运行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD opt]# ./key_app
Listening on /dev/input/event0 (LS2K300 99Pi Keys)
KEY0=148 KEY1=149, press Ctrl+C to stop
</code></pre>
<p>按下和松开<code>KEY0</code>、<code>KEY1</code>后，可以看到类似输出：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">KEY0 press   code=148 value=1 time=123.456789
KEY0 release code=148 value=0 time=123.556789
KEY1 press   code=149 value=1 time=125.123456
KEY1 release code=149 value=0 time=125.223456
</code></pre>
<h5 id="542-手动指定-event-设备">5.4.2 手动指定 event 设备</h5>
<p>如果程序没有自动找到 <code>input</code> 设备，可以手动指定：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD opt]# ./key_app --device /dev/input/event0
</code></pre>
<p>也可以限制打印事件数量：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD opt]# ./key_app --count 4
</code></pre>
<h4 id="55-常见问题">5.5 常见问题</h4>
<h5 id="551-驱动加载后没有-probe-日志">5.5.1 驱动加载后没有 probe 日志</h5>
<p>先确认设备树中是否存在<code>keys</code>节点：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD ~]# grep -aR "ls2k300-99pi-keys" /proc/device-tree 2&gt;/dev/null
/proc/device-tree/keys/compatible:ls2k300-99pi-keys
</code></pre>
<p>再确认驱动 <code>alias</code> 是否匹配：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD ~]# modinfo /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/ls2k300_99pi_keys.ko | grep alias
alias:          of:N*T*Cls2k300-99pi-keysC*
alias:          of:N*T*Cls2k300-99pi-keys
</code></pre>
<p>可以看到模块 <code>alias</code> 是<code>ls2k300-99pi-keys</code>，和设备树一致。</p>
<h5 id="552-找不到-input-设备">5.5.2 找不到 input 设备</h5>
<p>检查驱动是否加载：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD ~]# lsmod | grep ls2k300_99pi_keys
</code></pre>
<p>检查 <code>platform device</code> 和 <code>driver</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">[root@LS-GD ~]# ls /sys/bus/platform/devices | grep -i key
keys

[root@LS-GD ~]# ls /sys/bus/platform/drivers/ls2k300_99pi_keys
bind  keys  module  uevent  unbind
</code></pre>
<p>如果有 <code>device</code>，也有 <code>driver</code>，但是没有 <code>probe</code> 日志，通常就是<code>compatible</code>或模块 <code>alias</code> 不匹配。</p>
<h5 id="553-按键一直是按下状态或状态相反">5.5.3 按键一直是按下状态或状态相反</h5>
<p>久久派<code>KEY0</code>/<code>KEY1</code>是低有效按键，设备树必须写：</p>
<pre><code class="language-dts">key0-gpios = &lt;&amp;gpio 44 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW&gt;;
key1-gpios = &lt;&amp;gpio 45 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW&gt;;
</code></pre>
<p>如果误写成<code>GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH</code>，按键逻辑会反过来。</p>
